tasks.title: Option A.1: positions table, drop job_title from employment_details
tasks.notes: Done. positions table added (unique title, timestamps); db/06_positions.sql migrates populated installs: guarded create, title backfill, employment_details repoint (add position_id, backfill, NOT NULL, FK_DET_POSITION), job_title drop, verification queries dropping no rows - re-runnable, live-verified twice (run + clean no-op). Fresh rebuild path updated in 01_schema/00_drop/04_seed (positions seeded before details merge). Web: PositionId/PositionName replace JobTitle across EmploymentDetail, EmployeeWithDetails, WatchlistEntry; ILookupRepository.GetPositionsAsync; create/update forms use position dropdowns; dashboard watchlists show position names. Live smoke tests: pages render, create replacing-current POST succeeded then reverted - DB state restored to exactly prior (10 rows, Bilal open Operations Manager).

tasks.title: Option A.2: leave_types, leave_requests, leave_balances
tasks.notes: Done. DB: leave_types/leave_statuses/leave_requests/leave_balances + uq_lr_open_request (Pending id 1 guard); 00/01/03/04 updated, db/07_leave.sql re-runnable migration (ran live twice, second run no-op). Data: LeaveRequest/LeaveBalance/AbsenceStats/LeaveStatusIds, ILeaveRepository (+typed exceptions: DuplicateOpenLeaveRequest, InvalidLeaveDates, InsufficientLeaveBalance), leave lookups in ILookupRepository, statistics OnLeaveToday watchlist + GetAbsenceStats. Web: LeaveController (Index/Create/Approve/Reject/Cancel/Balances/UpsertBalance), leave views + scoped leave.css, nav + Employee Details links, dashboard On-leave-today card and absence strip. Gap found and fixed beyond the plan: DeleteWithDetailsAsync now purges leave_requests/leave_balances before employees (FK_LR_EMPLOYEE/FK_BAL_EMPLOYEE would otherwise block the destructive delete); Delete view help text updated. Live smoke on populated db: overlap and duplicate-open inline errors, approve consumed 2 days then cancel refunded them, over-entitlement gate named remaining days, reject + terminal-state guard, entitlement-below-used gate, purge probe employee with job+leave rows deleted cleanly. DB restored to pre-smoke state (4 requests incl. prior residue, 3 balances). Build green; only pre-existing NU1902/NU1903 warnings.
